query: SELECT s.stream_title AS "stream_title!", s.avg_viewers::float8 AS "avg_viewers!", s.followers_start::int8 AS followers_start FROM twitch_stream_sessions s JOIN twitch_streamers t ON LOWER(t.twitch_login) = LOWER(s.streamer_login) WHERE t.twitch_user_id = $1 AND s.started_at BETWEEN $2 AND $3 AND s.stream_title IS NOT NULL AND s.stream_title != '' AND s.avg_viewers IS NOT NULL ORDER BY s.started_at DESC
